description: This file defines the InterviewAttachmentModel class used in the Recruitment API portion of the OrangeHRM system. The class models an attachment related to a recruitment interview, encapsulating properties such as id, interviewId, attachment details (fileName, fileType, fileSize), and comments. It implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits for serialization.

classes.name: InterviewAttachmentModel
classes.description: A model representing the attachment associated with a recruitment interview, used for serialization and API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a RecruitmentAttachment entity, setting up filters and attribute mappings.
